sql:
select cls, cast(fish_date_doy/10 as int)*10 as doy_bucket,
  sum(yt) as yt, sum(anglers) as anglers, round(sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0),3) as ypa, count(*) as n_trips
from trips
where fish_date_season=6 and fish_date_doy between 90 and 152
  and cls in ('three_quarter','hd_am','hd_pm','hd_unspecified','overnight','day_1_5','full_day','hd_twilight')
group by 1,2
order by 1,2

# Notes — S06 d152 planning turn

## Current state: $20 budget, 0 PTO, season_score 14.0568 (rank 5/34 this season)
Cheapest bookable fare is $80 (HD_AM/PM weekend/holiday, TWILIGHT) and we only
have $20 — genuinely nothing left to book for the rest of S06 (d152→~d330),
PTO or no PTO. **Directive for remaining nightly turns this season: just log
a one-line journal note and pass, no analysis needed, every action will be
rejected/impossible.** Don't waste turns reasoning about offers.

## How we got here (S06 bookings, all confirmed in results.json)
Persona default ("wait for autumn") was overridden correctly starting ~d93:
booked 1 OVERNIGHT + 10 THREE_QUARTER between d93-d112 (all weekend/PTO-
laddered), then 1 more THREE_QUARTER-class HD_PM flyer at d129. $1900 of
$2000 spent by d112, shares mostly strong (0.11-2.34, several >1.0, THREE_
QUARTER pooled ypa 1.0-2.0 that whole window). This is a big improvement
over S02's result (see below).

## Fresh data check this turn: doy90-152 ypa-by-class (fish_date_season=6)
THREE_QUARTER stayed hot far longer than we had budget to exploit:
ypa by 10-day doy bucket — 90:1.38, 100:1.25, 110:1.98, 120:1.07, 130:1.26,
140:0.82, **150:0.30 (fading now)**. So the real THREE_QUARTER window this
season ran ~doy90-145, about 55 days, not just the doy93-112 burst we caught.
We simply ran out of $ by d112 — not a bad call, just under-paced.
HD_AM/HD_PM stayed ~0.00-0.015 ypa every bucket doy90-140 (confirmed dead,
consistent with d121 finding) but ticked up at doy150: HD_AM 0.111, HD_PM
0.105 — a possible new/late signal, can't act on it this season (no budget)
but worth checking again at next planning turn if we ever get one.
OVERNIGHT bounced around 0.2-1.0 ypa all window, no clear trend.
DAY_1_5 noisy/thin sample, dropped to ~0 at doy130 then partial recovery.

## Cross-season comparison (S02 practice vs S06) — THE key lesson
**S02** (persona default, uncorrected for most of the season): held full
$2000/10 PTO waiting for a "confirmed doy240+ autumn window," made a few
speculative $150 THREE_QUARTER bets along the way, and was **broke ($0) by
d243** — right as the real bloom that season (DAY_1_5, doy250-310, ypa often
2-5, frequently hit the 5.0 cap) ran for ~60 days with zero ability to touch
it. Final score 0.4349, rank 22. Root cause: no budget pacing plan, and PTO
committed in one 10-day ladder that partly went to waste when budget died
first.
**S06** (corrected mid-season): recognized early (by ~d90) that THREE_QUARTER
was hot *immediately*, not late, and front-loaded it. Result: 14.06 season
score, rank 5, MUCH better — but we still front-loaded too hard (11 of 12
trips in a 20-day burst, d93-112) and then had nothing left for the rest of
the ~55-day hot window that the fresh data above shows actually lasted to
~doy145. A more evenly-paced spend across doy90-145 would likely have scored
even higher (more total trips against a still-hot class instead of hitting
diminishing returns risk on any single burst).

## Directive for next season start (or next planning turn if mid-season)
1. **Do not trust the "wait for autumn" persona prior blindly.** Re-run the
   doy-bucket ypa-by-class query in the first planning turn of every season
   and let *that season's* actual data decide when/what to book. S02 and S06
   had completely different bloom timing (S02: late DAY_1_5 bloom doy250-310;
   S06: early-to-mid THREE_QUARTER bloom doy90-145). Don't assume either
   pattern repeats.
2. **Pace budget across the confirmed hot window, don't burst it in the
   first 2 weeks.** Rule of thumb: $2000/$150 ≈ 13 THREE_QUARTER trips is
   the ceiling if that class stays hot all season. If early data shows a
   window that might last N weeks, target spending roughly 1900/N per week,
   re-checking each planning turn / periodically as new doy buckets confirm
   whether the window is holding, fading, or a new class is heating up (like
   the HD uptick spotted at doy150 here) — re-pace up or down accordingly
   rather than committing the whole budget on the first confirmation.
3. **PTO: commit only 2-3 weekday dates ahead at a time** (14-day minimum
   lead), and re-check remaining budget before extending the ladder further.
   Previously wasted 5 of 10 committed PTO days this way (S06 d121 note) —
   avoid a repeat.
4. THREE_QUARTER ($150) is the best trips-per-dollar high-ypa class seen in
   both seasons so far when hot — always check it first each season, it's
   cheap enough to buy real volume. DAY_1_5 ($550) can be hotter per-trip
   (S02: 2-5 ypa) but buys far fewer trips per dollar; only lean into it if
   THREE_QUARTER isn't the hot class that season, or after THREE_QUARTER
   volume is already secured and budget remains.
5. HD_AM/HD_PM/TWILIGHT are consistently near-dead (0.00-0.02 ypa) across
   most of both seasons observed — only take them as truly free (0 PTO,
   $80, weekend/holiday) fillers when nothing else is affordable AND a
   specific boat shows real 2-day-persistence signal, not just a nonzero
   pooled 30-day average (that can hide all-zero recent trips). Expect weak
   shares even then (S06 d129 bet: 0.074 share) — fine as a last-dollar use,
   not worth chasing hard.

## Forum
Not posting this turn — no new information since last check worth sharing
publicly, and with budget/PTO already exhausted for the season there's no
defensive reason to protect an edge either way. Revisit at season end.
